diagram_math_checks.justification: Statement lines 36–44 and local def-completion-of-a-normed-space Definition identify exactly these objects.

diagram_math_checks.maps: i:X→widehat X; T:X→Y; widehat T:widehat X→Y. All three arrowheads point toward the codomain. The dashed arrow indicates the extension whose existence and uniqueness are asserted.
diagram_math_checks.justification: The completion definition makes i a linear isometry. T is given in the Statement. Step 3.1 constructs widehat T; steps 4.1, 4.2 and 5.1 establish additivity, the bound and homogeneity; step 6.1 proves uniqueness.

diagram_math_checks.relation: The only commuting relation is widehat T ∘ i = T, pointwise widehat T(i(x))=T(x). There is no arrow out of Y or asserted inverse.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 2.1 defines S(i(x))=T(x); step 3.1 extends S and states this exact equality.
